sample_mapping_evidence: Three original blood observations from two source people: DRESS patient before/after treatment and one age/sex-matched healthy volunteer per primaryPMC7105105. Skin controls and in-vitro culture aliquots do not add blood specimens. PBMC_POST preparation discrepancy remains explicit.

source_metadata.access: Public original filtered legacy10x UMI H5 files
source_processing: CellRanger (10X Genomics) pipelines were used for demultiplexing base calls into Fastq, filtering, barcode counting and filtering, UMI counting and alignment with reference human genome GRCh38.
The quality control, normalization, linear regression of number of UMIs and scaling were performed using Seurat (v2.3.4).
Two different groups (disease vs. healthy volunteers, pre- vs. post-treatment) were aligned using canonical correlation analysis by Seurat package (v2.3.4).
Supplementary_files_format_and_content: *.h5: Filtered gene expression matrices with cells identified as cell barcodes and the values representing gene UMI counts.
